criteria.description: task.pdf and Alice.eml exist and are parseable native PDF/MIME files.
The PDF contains all 12 source task names and a readable task-table rendering.
The PDF preserves the source task order and does not introduce unsupported task rows.
Alice.eml is addressed to Alice and contains task.pdf as an attachment with the correct filename.
The email body identifies the attached project task PDF for review and the attachment bytes match task.pdf.
The solver-visible workbook matches the immutable OfficeBench source hash.
